author: Adobe Creative Cloud
description:
Two filmmaking amateurs, Colt and Tejas, plan to capture M81, a galaxy 12,000,000 light years away. The problem? Neither know the first step in this process and run into no joke… every obstacle possible. 

Rough Cut! is a trial-by-fire creative show. In every episode, hosts Colt and Tejas reverse-engineer the secrets of world-class storytellers, then put them to the test by creating their own version from scratch: their ‘rough cut’! Made possible by Adobe, the project acts as an unfiltered creator diary, documenting the raw stress, late nights, and technical pivots required to take an impossible idea from concept to execution.
